ITEM 1 | Leafy greens, bright to mid green with ruffled edges and thin stems, spread across the upper-left part of the plate, covering roughly 25% of the plate's area; matte, slightly moist, piled about 2 cm high | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark, glossy wilted greens with deep purple-red stems and veins, sitting in the upper-right corner, covering roughly 8% of the plate; limp and slightly shiny, about 1 cm high | 30
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-white florets of cooked cauliflower, scattered among the greens, each piece about 2-3 cm across with slightly browned edges; firm, holding shape, sitting on top of and beside the greens | 35
ITEM 4 | Crumbly golden-brown mixture of small grains or lentil-like pieces with a coarse, grainy texture, covering the lower-center of the plate about 25% of its area and piled about 2 cm high; dry-looking with light sheen, mixed with orange-tinted bits | 90
ITEM 5 | Pieces of golden-orange, lightly browned cooked vegetable or tofu-like chunks, about 2-3 cm, with a slightly bumpy, crisp-edged surface, mixed into the grain mixture in the lower center of the plate | 55
ITEM 6 | Thin, bright green chopped herb leaves and small sprigs scattered over the lower-left portion of the grain mixture, matte and fresh-looking, covering about 5% of the plate | 8
ITEM 7 | Light orange-tan, slightly glossy coating or sauce film visible on the chunks and grains in the lower portion, giving a moist, spiced appearance, covering about 5% of the plate | 12
